invariants.description: stretch gate: m_r = m_r_inf(r) + (m_r_init - m_r_inf) exp(-t/tau_r), m_r_inf = 1/(1 + exp(-(r - r_50)/k_r))
voltage gate: m_V = m_V_inf(Vm) + (m_V_init - m_V_inf) exp(-t/tau_V), m_V_inf = 1/(1 + exp(-(Vm - V_50)/k_V))

bc_sweep.rationale: stretch ratio 1.0-1.3 (unstretched to strongly stretched membrane), clamp potential -100 to +40 mV, reversal 0 mV (non-selective cation, as measured for Piezo1) to +70 mV (pure Na); gate initial values over [0, 1]; V_50 -60 to +20 mV; other constants by factors 0.5-2.

baseline.reason: candidate: Piezo1 pressure/stretch-response and I-V data (Coste et al. 2010, Science 330:55) once the model's stretch variable is mapped to the experimental stimulus; owner to choose.

calibrate.note: pending: r_50, k_r, tau_r and g could be identified from the same data.
